entries.what: Finished the night shift, came home and slept; Election Day passed without him voting at the community center, as he was asleep.
entries.outcome: Slept through most of the day

entries.what: Did laundry at home and chatted with Arjun about the Measure K signs in the lot, then prepped for the shift.

entries.outcome: Transfer sent, one lift session done
